newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin rebounds on technical adjustment.
newsitem.headline: KL tin rebounds on technical adjustment.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia rebounded to finish 25 cents higher at 14.56 ringgit ($5.77) a kg after a firmner London market prompted renewed support.
Traders said the rise was also attributed to a technical adjustment to falls in recent days.
"The rebound was expected. There was active buying from merchants in the KLTM after the market fell sharply in recent days here," a trader said. Gains in London also boosted local prices.
Tin price fell to a new 19-month low of 14.31 ringgit on Tuesday, traders said.

The trader added strong buying was seen at the opening level. The market saw an opening bid of 201 tonnes against offer at 45. Final volume settled at 75 tonnes against 105 on Tuesday, with buying mainly from Europe and Malaysia.
Traders said the market is expected to hover around current levels or rise to 15 ringgit, unless the London market moves down in short-term.
The local price differential over London fell to $100 a tonne premium from $140 previously. --Tan Lee Lee (603-230-8911) ($1=2.5235 ringgit)
